'''Henderika Maria (Rie) de Boois''' ([[Zierikzee]], 4 June 1936 – [[Kerk-Avezaath]], 16 November 2010) was a Dutch politician and biologist. She was a member of the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|house of representatives]] from 1972 until 1987 for the [[Labour Party (Netherlands)|Labour Party]].

== Early life and science ==
De Boois was the eldest of 6 children. She studied biology at [[Utrecht University]] until 1962.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.volkskrant.nl/gs-bb81ab1f|title=Kamerlid dat het milieu op de PvdA-agenda zette|date=2010-12-13|website=de Volkskrant|language=nl-NL|access-date=2019-12-07}}</ref> She became a teacher at the Dutch National Institute for Nature Conservation after finishing her degree.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.vn.nl/vechtster-voor-een-beter-milieu/|title=Vechtster voor een beter milieu|date=2011-01-07|website=Vrij Nederland|language=nl|access-date=2019-12-08}}</ref> She later graduated from the same university with a PhD in 1976, with her thesis titled ''Schimmelgroei in strooisellagen van enkele bosgronden'' (English: Grow of fungi in the litterfall of forests).<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://web.science.uu.nl/pmi/Proefschriften.htm|title=Proefschriften|last=|first=|date=|website=web.science.uu.nl|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2019-12-07}}</ref>

== Political career ==
De Boois was a member of the [[Municipal council (Netherlands)|municipal council]] of [[Arnhem]] from 1966 until 1974.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.omroepgelderland.nl/nieuws/773781/Oud-Kamerlid-De-Boois-overleden|title=Oud-Kamerlid De Boois overleden|website=Omroep Gelderland|date=18 November 2010 |language=NL|access-date=2019-12-07}}</ref> De Boois was mainly involved in environmental matters. She fought for protection of the [[Wadden Sea]], was a proponent of increased Dutch involvement in Antarctic research<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=8gllZDQmQWUC&q=Rie+de+Boois&pg=PA115|title=Antarctic Policymaking and Science in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany (1957-1990)|last=Abbink|first=Benjamin Peter|date=2009|publisher=Barkhuis|isbn=978-90-77922-60-6|language=en}}</ref> and advocated for better forest management.<ref>{{Cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=6UItDwAAQBAJ&q=Rie+de+Boois&pg=PA79|title=Managing Northern Europe's Forests: Histories from the Age of Improvement to the Age of Ecology|last1=Oosthoek|first1=K. Jan|last2=Hölzl|first2=Richard|date=2018-02-19|publisher=Berghahn Books|isbn=978-1-78533-601-0|language=en}}</ref> In 1976 she tried to abolish the use of driving in the hunt of wild boars. However, she faced resistance from members of the royal family and other people of nobility.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://natuurtijdschriften.nl/download?type=document;docid=590550|title=IN MEMORIAM RIE DE BOOIS|last=Thissen|first=Johan|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref> The law would not come into effect until 2002. She was named 'Animal Protector of the Year' in 1986 for her work in animal conservation.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3" />

De Boois left the house of representatives in 1987.<ref name=":2" /> She became chairwoman of a [[Water board (Netherlands)|water board]] in charge of water quality in the [[Gooi]], [[Amstel]] and [[Vecht (Utrecht)|Vecht]].<ref name=":2" /> She was the chairwomen of the Dutch Society for the Protection of Birds from 1996 until 2004.<ref name=":3" />

Part of her inheritance was used to start the Rie de Boois-fund, which the Dutch Mammal Society use to fund research by volunteers.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.zoogdiervereniging.nl/nieuws/2013/rie-de-boois-fonds-2013-toegekend-aan-werkgroep-kleine-marterachtigen|title=Rie de Boois-fonds 2013 toegekend aan Werkgroep Kleine Marterachtigen|website=De Zoogdiervereniging|language=nl|access-date=2019-12-08}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
In 1964 De Boois married Karel Nagel, himself a politician for the Labour Party and environmentalist.<ref name=":0" /> Their marriage ended in 1973. She later married Pierre Janssen, an art connoisseur.<ref name=":1" /> De Boois was a vegetarian.<ref name=":2" />
